## Check the shared standardization helper

```{r synthetic-standardization}
# Load shared R notebook functions into this temporary test session.
find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
    current <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
    repeat {
        if (file.exists(file.path(current, "FMD_Project.Rproj"))) {
            return(current)
        }
        parent <- dirname(current)
        if (identical(current, parent)) {
            stop("Open the existing RStudio project first")
        }
        current <- parent
    }
}

project_root <- find_project_root()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)
load_module <- function(name) {
    lines <- readLines(file.path(project_root, "R", paste0(name, ".Rmd")))
    starts <- which(startsWith(lines, "```{r"))
    ends <- which(trimws(lines) == "```")
    code <- lapply(starts, function(start) {
        finish <- ends[ends > start][1]
        paste(lines[(start + 1L):(finish - 1L)], collapse = "\n")
    })
    eval(parse(text = paste(code, collapse = "\n\n")), envir = parent.frame())
}

load_module("config")
load_module("run_manager")
load_module("helpers")
load_module("addon_insight_helpers")

# Ensure the two groups have substantially different age shares before adjustment.
mock <- data.table::data.table(
    cohort = rep(primary_groups, each = 4L),
    age_cell = rep(c("18-34", "18-34", "65+", "65+"), times = 2L),
    FMD = rep(c(0L, 1L), times = 4L),
    selected_probability = rep(c(0.2, 0.5), times = 4L),
    RAW_WEIGHT = c(2, 2, 8, 8, 8, 8, 2, 2)
)
common_cells <- find_common_cells(mock, "age_cell", min_cell_n = 1L)
stopifnot(setequal(common_cells, c("18-34", "65+")))

standardized <- standardize_weights(
    mock,
    raw_weights = mock$RAW_WEIGHT,
    cell_column = "age_cell",
    common_cells = common_cells
)
post_shares <- standardized[, .(
    weighted = sum(standardized_weight)
), by = .(cohort, age_cell)]
post_shares[, share := weighted / sum(weighted), by = cohort]
first <- post_shares[cohort == primary_groups[1]][order(age_cell)]$share
second <- post_shares[cohort == primary_groups[2]][order(age_cell)]$share
stopifnot(all(abs(first - second) < 1e-10))
stopifnot(abs(sum(first) - 1) < 1e-10)

cat("[PASS] Both groups have an identical post-standardization age distribution.\n")
```
